verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a voice and multimodal agent framework with a hosted cloud. A buyer could fairly ask whether it surfaces AI-generated insights from session data, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows building blocks: built-in metrics, transcript collection, audio recording and the Whisker debugger. None of it documents an in-product feature that generates AI insights or suggestions from a user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
